verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev doesn't document any cloud-based region/residency selection feature, but its self-hosting option ('run and manage the platform on your own infrastructure, giving you full control over your environment') indirectly lets a user choose where data lives by deploying to any region themselves. This is an indirect workaround rather than a built-in residency control. Missing for 10: explicit cloud region selection, data residency/compliance documentation (e.g., EU vs US data centers), and any first-party statement on data storage location choice for the hosted service.
